scope: First native per-token profiler tied to the actual Deep2 decode path. This is workstream 01 and 02 of the TPS blueprint: freeze the baseline and profile the critical path.

measurement.device: CPU only. No GPU acceleration active.

interpretation.sampling_is_not_the_bottleneck: mean_sample_ms 0.10 out of mean 5453.07, i.e. 0.002 percent. The bottleneck is entirely in IR execution.
interpretation.per_op_cost: 300 dispatches cost about 18.2 ms each on average. With 300 operations per token that is the whole 5.45 s.
interpretation.dominant_constraint: CPU scalar arithmetic in the ModelGenie primitives. Not weight bandwidth, not expert routing, not Vulkan kernel execution, not synchronisation - none of those are exercised on this path.
interpretation.variance: Max 9.46 s versus median 5.13 s indicates scheduling or memory-pressure jitter on this machine.

critical_blocker_for_the_stated_target.target: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B, baseline 128.78 TPS, goal 643.90 TPS (5x).
critical_blocker_for_the_stated_target.finding: The blueprint target model cannot run on this engine at all.
critical_blocker_for_the_stated_target.evidence: ollama show nemotron-3.5-lightning:30b reports architecture nemotron_h_moe, 32.9B parameters, Q4_K_M. ModelGenieExecutor implements the DeepSeek-V2 architecture: MLA attention with a 512-rank KV latent plus 64-dim RoPE, and the DeepSeek MoE. These are different model families.
critical_blocker_for_the_stated_target.consequence: A TPS number for Nemotron cannot be produced, improved, or certified on this engine without first implementing the nemotron_h_moe architecture. The 5x target is therefore not addressable as a performance task on this codebase.
critical_blocker_for_the_stated_target.measured_instead: DeepSeek-V2-Lite, 32.9B-versus-9.65GB caveat noted, achieves 0.18 TPS on CPU. Against the stated 128.78 TPS baseline that is roughly a 700x gap, and on a SMALLER model, so the gap is architecture-wide rather than model-size-specific.

harness_bug_fixed.issue: /Fe came after /link, so it was handed to the linker, which does not understand /Fe and ignored it with LNK4044. The executable was then named after the first source file and written to the current directory, so every build silently left a stale binary at tmp_build and produced an unlabelled one at the repo root.

what_was_added.profiler_flag: tools/rawrxd_modelgenie_ir_executor.cpp gains --profile, timing each step around Execute() and SampleToken() separately, and emitting the RAWRXD_DEEP2_PER_TOKEN_PROFILE_001 receipt.
what_was_added.steady_state: The first step is excluded from steady-state statistics because it carries one-off arena growth and page-fault costs.

not_claimed: No Nemotron measurement. The model cannot be loaded by this engine.
No TPS improvement toward 643.90. No optimisation has been attempted yet.
No GPU dispatch counters in this profile; the path measured is the CPU path.
